federation/sawgraph-spatial-hydrology-01.sparql:
#+ summary: How many sand and gravel aquifers spatially intersect each Maine town?
#+ tags:
#+   - federation

PREFIX gwml2: <http://gwml2.org/def/gwml2#>
PREFIX kwg-ont: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/ontology/>
PREFIX kwgr: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/resource/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX spatial: <http://purl.org/spatialai/spatial/spatial-full#>

SELECT ?cousub_name (COUNT(DISTINCT ?aq) AS ?num_aq) WHERE {
  # Find county subdivisions (towns) from Maine and their labels
  ?cousub rdf:type kwg-ont:AdministrativeRegion_3 ;
          kwg-ont:administrativePartOf+ kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 ;
          rdfs:label ?cousub_name .
  # Find S2 cells that intersect the county subdivisions
  ?s2 spatial:connectedTo ?cousub ;
      rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13	.
  # Find aquifers that intersect the county subdivision S2 cells
  ?aq rdf:type gwml2:GW_Aquifer .
  ?s2 spatial:connectedTo ?aq .
} GROUP BY ?cousub_name ORDER BY DESC(?num_aq)

pankgraph/non-acinar-cell-adhesion-regul.sparql:
#+ summary: Find genes expressed in pancreas acinar cells and regulating cell-matrix adhesion
#+ tags:
#+   - pankgraph
#+   - ubergraph

PREFIX cl: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_>
PREFIX go: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_>
PREFIX ro: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX biolink: <https://w3id.org/biolink/vocab/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?gene ?function {
    ?stmt1 rdf:subject ?gene ; rdf:predicate biolink:functional_association ; rdf:object ?function .
    ?stmt2 rdf:subject ?gene ; rdf:predicate biolink:expressed_in ; rdf:object cl:0002064 .
    ?function ro:0002211 go:0007160 .
}
